systems_found: Six public four-year institutions (University of Washington, Washington State University, Western Washington, Central Washington, Eastern Washington, The Evergreen State College)
State Board for Community and Technical Colleges (SBCTC, 34 colleges)

sources.institution: All public four-year institutions and all community and technical colleges, plus all state agencies
sources.system: State Employee Salary Database (OFM data, published by LEAP on fiscal.wa.gov)
sources.download_url: The full-database download link is sent by email after mailing leap@leg.wa.gov (the 'Download Data' button is a mailto link). The interactive view is an embedded Power BI report.
sources.coverage_years: rolling previous 5 calendar years (about 2020-2024 as of 2026; 2025 data expected in summer 2026)
sources.institutions_covered: UW, WSU, WWU, CWU, EWU, Evergreen, all SBCTC colleges, all state agencies
sources.employees: all, except student employees (names withheld for confidentiality and domestic-violence cases)
sources.format: Power BI (interactive); bulk file by email request (format not stated, historically CSV/XLSX)
fields: total_annual_earnings by calendar year (base plus overtime and premiums, rounded to $100)
sources.size: not stated (several hundred thousand rows for 5 years)
sources.terms: Published as a public service, not required by law (FAQ); no reuse terms stated
sources.blocker: The bulk file needs an email request to LEAP (a manual form-like step); the web view is Power BI only.
sources.notes: Official, comprehensive and clean once obtained: one manual email gets the whole 5-year file. Rated B instead of A only because of the email gate. Supporting PDFs: SalaryDataFAQ.pdf, SalaryPersonnelIncluded.pdf, SalarySpecial.pdf. No department field, only agency and job title. I did not send the email.

sources.institution: All state agencies and higher-ed institutions (agency 360 = UW, 365 = WSU, etc.)
sources.institutions_covered: all state agencies and higher-ed institutions
sources.notes: Historical only, but loads cleanly. UW (360) has about 97k rows and WSU (365) about 33k. Wide format, one column per year.

sources.blocker: Derived from the same OFM data; search-only, not authoritative.
sources.notes: Not needed given the official source.

gaps: Current years (2014+) have no public static bulk URL (email request to LEAP required). No department, FTE or hire date. Earnings are rounded to $100 and are calendar-year totals.
notes: Best rating is A because of the historical 2010-2013 Socrata file. For current data the LEAP database is rated B because of the email gate, which is the recommended route (one manual email). A data.virginia.gov 'Agency Salaries - Washington' mirror turned out to be agency totals only, so it was ignored.
